plan.title: Single-stage auction with optional terms and vendor bid

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as a single-stage auction; the catalog has no forward/sell direction setting.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available auction pricing template; the requested forward/sell template cannot be selected specifically.
Add the requested product as one line item and set its quantity to 10.
Populate the auction pricing sheet so the event is publishable.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-side bid.
Confirm that publishing reached the real event page.
Move to the supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the newly published auction in the vendor portal.
Submit the vendor's bid of 100; with no mandatory clauses configured by the available steps, this exercises the non-blocking bid path.
Assert that the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
